description: This file defines the interface 'X509CertificateChainValidator' for validating X.509 certificate chains, including two validation methods with different trust anchor inputs.

classes.name: X509CertificateChainValidator
classes.description: An interface for validating X.509 certificate chains based on trust anchors.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a certificate chain using a trust anchor, returns a Future that completes if valid or fails with CertificateException.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates a certificate chain using a set of trust anchors, returns a Future that completes if valid or fails with CertificateException.
